room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay applies to every admissible claim amount

sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year, whichever lower; Modern treatments: up to 50% of SI

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via portability credits; only declared and accepted PEDs covered after 36 months

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, etc.; 36-month list includes joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Code Excl 18

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate on claim; alternatively insured may opt No Claim Discount on premium instead

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy wording

pre_hosp.note: For same condition as admissible hospitalisation

post_hosp.note: From date of discharge for same condition

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; 24-hour time limit not applicable for day-care

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation excluded; covered only if Galaxy Smart Outpatient rider is opted

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full sum insured in any AYUSH Hospital

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; fixed cap of ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of SI; includes robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, etc.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded in Annexure-I List I

global_cover.note: Policy restricted to India; treatment outside India explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 30 days for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly premium payment

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; credits for PED waiting, specific waiting, moratorium transferable

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, domiciliary/OPD (unless rider), overseas treatment, sterility/IVF, gender change, cosmetic surgery, war, nuclear/bio/chemical

optional_riders.display: Galaxy Smart Outpatient rider (covers domiciliary & OPD); No Claim Discount (in lieu of Cumulative Bonus)
